# Nordwind Typography Kit (vendored)

Third-party typography helpers bundled with Academic Starter.
Upstream project: nordwind-themes (copied here so the theme builds offline).

## Modules

- `bibliography.css` - list styling for bibliography entries
- `bibtex.css` - BibTeX block rendering
- `tables.css` - table rules

## Bibliography notes

The bibliography module is intentionally minimal: it styles the bibliography
list produced by the publications collection. Upstream keeps the bibliography
helpers in a single stylesheet; we vendor that file unchanged.
